versions.content:
[SWS_DM_01525]
ara::diag::DoIPPowerMode
not yet offered when client re-
quests
DoIP
PowerMode
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_00080
⌈
If a client requests the DoIP power mode information, the DM shall send a DoIP power
mode information response with power mode value 0 ("Not ready"), as long as the
Offer function of the
ara::diag::DoIPPowerMode
interface is not called yet by the
Adaptive Application, that provides it (as defined in the ISO 13400-2[2] specification).
⌋
